method: Manual post-call comparison to solution.patch and base definitions; not blinded. Conditional correctness distinguished from runnable setup. Three usable criteria are not three fully covered features.

scenarios.note: Literal query `{ hero { name ... @defer } }` lacks the required fragment selection set. Conditional merge/hasNext answer is correct, but premise was approved and is not runnable.
Empty list plus stream items at index zero yields Luke/Leia and current hasNext flags; coherent for a scalar-list schema.
Deferred data without item path merges at root and preserves hero. Does not test earlier-result snapshot immutability.
Concrete correct consequence is in then but status is unresolved; no criterion emitted.
Explicit result-attribute requirements withheld because new implementation is absent; input payload is also underspecified.

Root data result agrees with solution. Wording does not completely specify wire incremental-item envelope; weak discriminator for missing-path merge.
No starting parent list. Outcome unresolved, premise nevertheless supported.

HTTP parts incorrectly wrap new fields in payload, copied from existing subscription format. Correct solution processes raw part JSON; hypothetical answer also uses {} instead of None for omitted HTTP extensions. Withheld.

Concrete HTTP error part wraps errors in payload. Solution reads top-level errors and therefore does not emit the claimed boom errors. Conditional continuation/lifetime intention is useful but literal approved criterion is wrong.
Withheld because implementation is absent. Initial top-level data plus incremental items would take solution initial-data branch; then cannot presume both get merged.
HTTP empty-incremental example wraps fields in payload, so does not exercise an actual empty incremental array. Added extensions empty/None assertion is ambiguous. Approved criterion is not ready.
Transport observation assumes merged data and True without a hasNext field or initial parent list. Transport forwards data=None for incremental-only messages; session accumulates. Withheld.
Existing DSLFragment.spread API correctly identified, but explicitly required new defer behavior withheld because method is absent.

No concrete data or hasNext flags; proposes final false on stream EOF without final payload. Withheld.

target_facets.g-stream-position: No fully correct overwrite/no-shift/padding criterion; stream-at-zero case only.
target_facets.g-progress-only: HTTP empty-array example has wrong wire wrapper; hasNext-only case withheld.
target_facets.g-error-continuation: Conditional intention present, literal HTTP errors wrapper incorrect.
target_facets.g-errors-lifetime: Conditional intention present, literal HTTP errors wrapper incorrect.

retrieval_limitations: Lexical ranking selects ParseResultVisitor for list/path/null terms; its existing scalar/result conversion semantics are not the new incremental merge contract.

comparison: Same task/model/frozen routing as prior experiments, but changed retrieval/context and decision prompts; a single adaptive sample, not a controlled causal improvement claim.
